subject.title: fix(talk): preserve owner authorization in realtime consults

question: Should OpenClaw publish and support `REALTIME_VOICE_AGENT_CONSULT_SENDER_AUTH_VERSION` as the stable compatibility contract for external realtime voice plugins?
rationale: The propagation fix uses an existing embedded-run authorization contract, but exporting a capability version creates a long-lived plugin SDK promise that cannot be safely inferred from this PR alone.

options.title: Approve the scoped capability contract
options.body: Keep the version export, document its semantics and compatibility expectation, and require focused host/plugin behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Use a different supported compatibility mechanism
options.body: Remove the new public version export and route plugin-host compatibility through an existing approved SDK or manifest mechanism if one is preferred.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped capability contract
recommendation.body: Keep the version export, document its semantics and compatibility expectation, and require focused host/plugin behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available routing candidate for the paired realtime integration and can clarify why this host capability contract is required.
